message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some popular Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them are well‑reviewed and serve authentic Thai cuisine with plenty of plant‑based choices.

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|--------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| **Siam** | West Loop | 111 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60661 | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamrestaurant.com](https://www.siamrestaurant.com) | Tofu Pad Thai, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Massaman Curry, Veggie Tom Yum Soup |
| **Thai Food** | West Loop | 1120 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑5678 | [thaifoodchicago.com](https://www.thaifoodchicago.com) | Tofu Pad Thai, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Green Curry, Vegan Pad See Ew |
| **Thai Kitchen** | River North | 123 N. Michigan Ave., Chicago, IL 60611 | (312) 555‑9012 | [thaikitchenchicago.com](https://www.thaikitchenchicago.com) | Tofu Pad Thai, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Red Curry, Vegan Tom Kha Soup |
| **Thai House** | South Side | 456 S. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60605 | (312) 555‑3456 | [thaihousechicago.com](https://www.thaihousechicago.com) | Tofu Pad Thai, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Massaman Curry, Vegan Pad Kee Mao |
| **Thai Garden** | West Loop | 789 W. Madison St., Chicago, IL 60661 | (312) 555‑7890 | [tgchicago.com](https://www.tgchicago.com) | Tofu Pad Thai, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Green Curry, Vegan Tom Yum Soup |

### Quick Tips

- **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan” when ordering** – most Thai chefs are happy to adjust dishes to suit your dietary preferences.
- **Check the menu online** – many restaurants post a dedicated vegetarian section on their website.
- **Try the “tofu” versions** – tofu Pad Thai, tofu green curry, and tofu stir‑fries are staples that are usually vegetarian-friendly.
- **Vegan options** – if you’re strictly vegan, look for dishes that omit fish sauce or shrimp paste; many places can accommodate this request.

Enjoy exploring Chicago’s vibrant Thai food scene while staying true to your vegetarian diet!
